channel.title: Deep Rest Practice Journal
channel.description: Short reads on the research behind relaxation.

item.title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation for Sleep: What a Meta-Analysis Found
item.description: A 2026 meta-analysis of 14 RCTs looked at progressive muscle relaxation for sleep quality. Here is what it found, its limits, and how to try it.

item.title: Yoga nidra for sleep: what a randomised trial found
item.description: A 2021 randomised trial tested yoga nidra for sleep in chronic insomnia. Here is how the practice was taught, what changed, and the limits.

item.title: Yoga Nidra Stress: What a 2026 Meta-Analysis Found
item.description: A 2026 meta-analysis of 73 studies on yoga nidra and stress: what it found, how large the effects were, and why the authors urge caution.

item.title: Yoga Nidra 10 Minutes: What an 11-Minute Study Found
item.description: An 11-minute yoga nidra audio was tested in a large, varied sample. Here is what the study measured and found, and how to try it.

item.title: Yoga Nidra for Sleep: What a Review of Trials Found
item.description: A systematic review of six randomised trials looked at yoga nidra for sleep. Here is what it found, what it could not show, and how to try it gently.

item.title: NSDR and Yoga Nidra: What the Research Says
item.description: NSDR, or non-sleep deep rest, draws on the older practice of yoga nidra. A 2022 review looks at what the research can and cannot show.
